question: Was the threat a lone individual or a radical organisation?

sideA.label: Police / MSWiA
sideA.text: A single man, about 60, was detained for threatening and planning an attack; he was previously known to services.

sideB.label: Media reports of tip
sideB.text: Polsat and TVN24 cite the tipster describing a radical group seeking volunteers for a firearms attack. Prosecutors say a recording shows the suspect recruiting a group of several hundred members.

resolution: Prosecutors allege recruitment; membership and any accomplices unverified.

question: Is there a foreign (Russian/Belarusian) link to the October threat?

sideA.label: Hybrid-threat framing
sideA.text: Poland has faced Russian-directed plots in 2026 (August case), so foreign links are being asked about.

sideB.label: Available facts
sideB.text: The suspect is a Polish citizen; no official has reported a foreign link to this case.

resolution: No foreign link reported as of Oct 11; the August case is separate.

question: How credible was the threat?

sideA.label: Special-services spokesman
sideA.text: Jacek Dobrzyński said the information was serious and credible enough to publish and the threats could likely be carried out.

sideB.label: Caution
sideB.text: Charges now filed (Oct 13) and explosive materials reportedly found; suspect denies the offences.

resolution: Charges filed; no trial findings yet.

question: Is it an 'assassination plot' or a threat case?

sideA.label: Officials
sideA.text: Kierwiński said the man 'threatened and planned an attack'; the SOP tip spoke of a planned attack.

sideB.label: Tusk's wording
sideB.text: Tusk described it as 'a man threatening an attack' who was detained.

question: Are the October case and the September threat arrests connected?

sideA.label: Unconnected
sideA.text: Interia's report does not link the Przemyśl and Oława arrests to this case.

sideB.label: Pattern
sideB.text: Repeated threats against Tusk within weeks suggest a climate of escalating political hostility.

resolution: No evidence of operational connection; pattern is interpretive.
